status.main_product: Aerial Drone and LiDAR surveying and mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone and LiDAR land surveying, aerial mapping, and GIS-based data solutions under its own name.
status.evidence: According to the official company website and LinkedIn registry, Sky2Earth Technology is an active drone intelligence provider based in Vadodara, offering aerial drone/LiDAR surveying, mapping, and GIS data solutions.

claims.claim: The company reports employing heavy-lift industrial drones equipped with stabilized gimbals alongside sensor integrations including professional-grade cameras with zoom lenses for visual data capture and LiDAR scanning payloads to generate dense 3D point clouds.
claims.note: heavy-lift industrial drones equipped with stabilized gimbals alongside sensor integrations including professional-grade cameras with zoom lenses for visual data capture

claims.claim: The company reports utilising drone thermography integrated with thermal sensors for specific asset monitoring, such as identifying anomalies or mapping solar panel installations.

The company reports offering web-based tools on its S2E Cloud platform to measure, calculate, and analyze drone data directly in a browser, including interactive dimension measurements, precise elevation readings, area measurements, cross-section profiling, and stockpile volumetrics to track material inventory.

The company reports utilizing advanced photogrammetry software to process aerial drone imagery into accurate 3D models, dense point clouds in formats like.LAS,.OBJ, and.PLY, and digital surface or terrain models (DSM/DTM) with customizable contour intervals.
claims.note: formats like .LAS, .OBJ, and .PLY, and customizable contour intervals

claims.claim: The company reports providing survey-grade precision that enables mining operators to achieve ±2% volume accuracy for earthwork and material stockpiles.

claims.note: "R&D excellence" as a specific stated feature and the metrics of over 1,500 flights and 1 million images

status.main_product: 3D laser scanning, mobile LiDAR scanning, and drone surveying services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone surveying services, aerial photogrammetry, and LiDAR mapping directly under its own name.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, Edge 3D Technologies provides drone surveying services including topographic mapping, aerial surveying, and high-resolution orthomosaic map deliverables.

claims.claim: The company reports providing drone surveying services that deliver detailed digital outputs, including ortho-mosaic maps, point clouds, and digital surface models (DSMs), which are formatted for integration into CAD and GIS environments.
The company reports performing point cloud processing and 3D modeling from data acquired via UAVs equipped with high-resolution cameras and LiDAR sensors.

Edge 3D Technologies utilized a FARO Focus3D X 330 laser scanner to collect point cloud data and generate as-built documentation to support the reinstallation of HVAC systems at a food processing facility.
claims.note: FARO Focus3D X 330 laser scanner, food processing facility, HVAC reinstallation

claims.claim: The company reports scanning more than 200 million square feet, 400 ships, and 60 industrial units across 20 countries, though its public portfolio heavily emphasizes terrestrial 3D laser scanning and Scan-to-BIM services (such as data capture for seven power substations and a fertilizer unit) over dedicated drone mapping projects.

Independent legal entity records from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) verify that Edge 3D Technologies Private Limited generated less than ₹10 Cr in total revenue for the financial year ending on March 31, 2025.
